text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that the parking regulations be amended on Sackville Street and Amelia Street. The proposed amendments will provide short-term parking to accommodate pick-up and drop-off activity for the proposed daycare at 459-461 Sackville Street. These parking amendments will also help deter double sided parking on the sides of the streets abutting this property during pick-up and drop-off hours of operation.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Deferred consideration of the Item until such time as the owner of 459-461 Sackville Street has been granted a licence by the Minister of Education to operate a daycare at the site, and such approval has been provided to Transportation Services, the City Solicitor, and the local Ward Councillor for review. 2. Requested Transportation staff to provide a supplementary report on the item to include information on the nature of the daycare licence and whether it changes the analysis contained in the report (August 23, 2021) from the Acting Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
